title: Reproduction package: Measuring the impact of multi-signature self-custody on crypto-wallet usability and security perception
description:
Pseudonymized data (n = 67), analysis scripts, notebooks, and outputs that reproduce every statistic, table, and figure in the Results section of the article Measuring the impact of multi-signature self-custody on crypto-wallet usability and security perception. The experiment is a between-subjects usability study of the Shared-custody with Self pattern: participants completed a cryptocurrency spending task with the Safe wallet on the Ethereum Sepolia test network under one of four treatments (single-signature on mobile or desktop, 2-of-2 multi-signature initiated on desktop or on mobile) and answered the System Usability Scale and a security-perception questionnaire.

The package is managed with uv (pinned Python 3.11 and dependency lock file). Run uv sync, uv run scripts/analysis.py, and uv run scripts/verify.py to regenerate and check all results. See README.md and data/CODEBOOK.md.
